intent: The relay acceptance was followed by an unknown station asking who had just requested medicine. I did not answer. The drone can home on my carrier, which means anyone watching the sky or monitoring the band may be able to follow it toward the house. I tell Mike to keep my grid off the walkie, watch the road and tree line, and treat the delivery as both rescue and exposure.
emotion: excited and hopeful, technically focused, trying to remain cautious over an open channel
